cd /home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_4/projects/trace-verdict-study/docs/paper

for label in "${LABELS[@]}"; do
  found=0
  files_and_lines=""
  
  for file in main.tex introduction.tex related_work.tex method.tex experiments.tex discussion.tex conclusion.tex; do
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
      matches=$(grep -n "\\\\ref{$label}" "$file" 2>/dev/null)
      if [ ! -z "$matches" ]; then
        found=1
        while IFS= read -r line; do
          files_and_lines="${files_and_lines}${file}: $line | "
        done <<< "$matches"
      fi
    fi
  done
  
  if [ ! -f "limitations.tex" ]; then
    # limitations.tex doesn't exist in the file list
    :
  fi
  
  if [ $found -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "✓ $label"
    echo "  $files_and_lines"
  else
    echo "✗ $label"
  fi
done
